title: Cabinet approves ₹18,662 Crore Brahmaputra underwater road-cum-rail tunnel
summary: Cabinet approved 33.7 km Gohpur-Numaligarh 4-lane underwater tunnel under Brahmaputra River in Assam (2nd in world after Germany-Denmark).
